newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Country Road sees big profit drop.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Country Road sees big profit drop.

text.p: Retailer Country Road Ltd said on Tuesday group trading profit for the first half of the 1996/97 year could be more than 50 percent below last year's record result for the first half.

"Based on a decline in Australasian sales of at least seven percent, group trading profit could be more than 50 percent below last year's record result in the first half," Country Road said in a statement.

"Like other retailers in Australasia we were depending upon a surge in Christmas sales boosted by improved confidence from the interest rate cuts," chief executive officer Mike Howell said in a statement.
"This did not eventuate and the Christmas trading environment was the worst the company has experienced resulting in sales substantially below our expectations," Howell said.
Country Road shares closed six cents higher at A$1.68.
